fact: The PFM Reforms Strategy of May 2025 states that government PFM systems (IFMS, e-GP, HCM payroll control) automate financial transactions and lists IFMS and IPPS upgrades and e-Tax among its reform actions for July 2025 to June 2030.
title: Government of Uganda PFM Reforms Strategy July 2025 - June 2030
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development
